title: Option B follow-up: bounded authenticated solicited-unicast-DIO admission (RFC 6550 8.3 SHOULD)
description: Follow-up to project-LICHEN-worker6-ehcn (closed with option A: solicited DIS responses re-targeted to RPL_ALL_NODES multicast, receive.rs:633). Option A is RFC-compliant (unicast response is a SHOULD, not MUST) and matches the R-09-005 admission gate + Python parity. If RFC-optimal solicited unicast DIO responses are ever wanted, implement option B: admit unicast-dst DIOs iff dst == own link-local AND hop 255 AND Rule 255 AND link-authenticated AND replay-fresh AND a matching authenticated DIS was admitted from that peer within a bounded window (solicitation ledger). Requires: Python mirror (dis.py UNICAST_DIO_WITH_CONFIGURATION receiver side), spec 09 normative text, and the ledger must run admission against the provisioned DODAG state (worker-6's scope-mismatch hazard: DodagState commit revalidation with zeroed scope — see 5byi). Not a conformance fix — an enhancement.
